title: Watch: 'Time for Ukraine to get a new president', says Trump
summary: The US president's said President Volodymyr Zelensky "wants to make problems for the world".

blocks.text: US President Donald Trump has called for new leadership in Ukraine, criticising President Volodymyr Zelensky for striking Russian oil refineries.
"It's time for Ukraine to get a new president" he told reporters.
On Friday Trump announced a deal with Moscow to import Russian diesel, a deal Zelensky described as "a gift" to President Putin.
